marks.gloss_en: on the third of Marcheshvan one requests rain
איני?! והא בעו מיניה משמואל: מאימת מדכרינן ותן טל ומטר? אמר להו: מכי מעיילי ציבי לבי טבות רישבא
דילמא אידי ואידי חד שיעורא הוא -- perhaps both are one measure
they asked Shmuel: from when do we mention 'and give dew and rain'? He told them: from when they bring wood into the house of Tavut the fowler
R' Elazar: the halakha follows Rabban Gamliel
Rav: the sixtieth day is like after sixty
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: and your mnemonic -- those above need water, those below do not need water
the land of Egypt is four hundred parsa by four hundred parsa
R' Oshaya: what is meant by 'you who dwell on many waters, abundant in storehouses' (Jer 51:13)? what caused Babylonia's storehouses to be full of grain? say: because it dwells on many waters
if the seventeenth of Marcheshvan arrived and rain did not fall, individuals begin to fast three fasts
תניא נמי הכי: כשהתחילו היחידים להתענות מתענין שני וחמישי ושני
the baraita: when the individuals begin to fast, they fast Monday, Thursday and Monday
[the stam: who are the individuals?] Rav Huna: the Sages
אמר מר: מתמתקין בעבים -- מנליה? R' Yochanan (via Rav Yitzchak bar Yosef): חשכת / חשרת, read חכשרת -- the waters are made fit in the clouds

R' Yochanan: it is written 'darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies' (Ps 18:12) and 'a gathering of waters, thick clouds of the skies' (2 Sam 22:12): take the kaf, put it on the reish, and read חכשרת -- the waters' being made fit [is in] the thick clouds
סבר לה כי הא דכי אתא רב דימי -- dark clouds have much water: R' Yehoshua reads the two verses as weather lore, not as sweetening
in the West they say: bright clouds -- their waters are few; dark clouds -- their waters are many
ההוא בברייתו של עולם -- that verse is about the creation of the world (= p_yehoshua_briat_olam)
the stam for R' Yehoshua: that verse speaks of the creation of the world
כמאן אזלא הא דתניא... כרבי יהושע. ורבי אליעזר -- the baraita has rain as the fruit of the upper waters; how does R' Eliezer account for its verse?
ההוא במעשה ידיו של הקדוש ברוך הוא הוא דכתיב -- that verse is written of the Holy One's handiwork (= p_eliezer_maaseh_yadav)
the baraita: the upper waters hang by the [divine] word, and their fruit is rain water -- as it says 'the earth is sated from the fruit of Your works' (Ps 104:13)
Eretz Yisrael was created first and the whole world afterwards -- as it says 'while He had not yet made the land and the outer places' (Prov 8:26)
Eretz Yisrael drinks rain water and the whole world from the residue -- as it says 'who gives rain on the land' etc. (Job 5:10)
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: the whole world drinks from the residue of the Garden of Eden
